summary: Frontend-only PWA end-to-end testing completed. All 11 modules load without runtime errors. Login → cockpit flow works. All sidebar navigation testids resolve and route correctly. Cockpit KPIs, inspiration carousel, task/program toggles, deliverable accept work. Copilote send + suggestions dispatch messages (toasts confirm), Vision ambiance toggle Élan↔Refuge works, Faith-Toggle default OFF and switches ON to show vision.verse in Refuge (verified by code). Vision Board tabs (roue/roadmap/identite/moodboard/cockpit) all render. Croissance pipeline advances. Agenda qualified filter works. Mindset decisions work. Paramètres theme toggle visibly switches dark ↔ light (body bg rgb(15,23,42) → rgb(248,250,252)). Header profile menu / theme / ambiance work. Logout link present. Mobile viewport (390px) exposes header-menu-btn which opens the sidebar drawer.

ui_bugs.issue: Sonner toast in top-right position intercepts pointer events over header-notifications-btn and header-messages-btn while a toast is visible, making them un-clickable for 4–6 seconds after each toast fires. Consider moving toaster to top-center/bottom-right or setting pointer-events:none on the toast container root.

design_issues.screen: All pages with Recharts (Pilotage cashflow, Bien-être mood, VisionBoard radar)
issues: Numerous Recharts console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Charts do render eventually but the ResponsiveContainer parent lacks a minHeight/minWidth or is measured before layout — add explicit heights (e.g., h-64) or minHeight on ResponsiveContainer to silence and prevent brief 0-size layout flashes.

action_items: Fix Sonner toast overlay intercepting header buttons: adjust <Toaster /> position or add pointer-events:none to the toast wrapper so the header dropdown triggers remain clickable while toasts are visible.
Add explicit min heights on ResponsiveContainer usages (Pilotage, Bien-être, VisionBoard) to eliminate Recharts width/height(-1) warnings and initial 0-size flash.
critical_code_review_comments: Toaster from sonner is mounted at top-right (default) — overlaps with the header controls. Either reposition or ensure pointer-events pass-through on the wrapper.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer inside cards lacks minHeight; a few chart containers momentarily report -1 dimensions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 routes and every data-testid referenced in the review request are present and functional. Only two non-blocking issues remain: (1) sonner toast overlay blocks header notification/messages buttons intermittently; (2) Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings. No runtime errors on any route. Faith-Toggle correctly reveals vision.verse in Refuge mode (Vision.jsx lines 117–122).
rca of the issue: Sonner default position is top-right which occupies the exact z-index area of the header actions; while a toast is present, its <li> intercepts pointer events for the underlying header dropdown triggers, causing Playwright's click to time out and real users to require a second click after the toast fades.
